A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 18-page paper, including Figures 1–2, Tables 1–2, and Appendix A. Full text comparison and rendered-page checks support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original GRPO experiments on math benchmarks, with accuracy and response-length results in Tables 1–2 and a discount-factor sweep in Figure 2.

after.justification: v3 retains the original GRPO experiments, numerical results in Tables 1–2, and discount-factor sweep in Figure 2.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same discounted correctness objective, reasoning-token masking, undiscounted formatting rewards, and moving-reference KL regularization. Equations (1)–(2) are unchanged.

E1.justification: Coverage remains identical: GSM8K, MATH, DeepScaleR training data, and evaluation on AMC 2023, AIME 2025, MINERVA, and OLYMPIAD. No task or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same undiscounted GRPO comparators for every model/dataset pairing. No comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Sections 4–5 retain identical model configurations, completion limits, token-budget controls, greedy decoding, evaluation metrics, and discount-selection procedures.

E4.justification: The Qwen3 1.7B discount-factor sweep on GSM8K (Figure 2) and the reported effects of discounting entire responses (Section 4.3) are unchanged. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions report three training seeds and ten evaluation seeds for GSM8K/MATH, paired evaluation seeds across methods, and five evaluation seeds for the other benchmarks. Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All accuracy and response-length entries in Tables 1–2, the plotted results in Figure 2, and the numerical and qualitative findings in the text are identical.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, Blackwell-optimality results, discount-factor bounds, and proofs in Sections 2–3 and Appendix A are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about Blackwell optimality in restricted policy classes and shortening reasoning while preserving accuracy.

C2.justification: Interpretations of aggressive discounting, formatting failures, and instance-dependent accuracy–length tradeoffs remain unchanged, as does the open question of whether compressed reasoning improves generalization.

D1.justification: Sections 4–5 retain the same implementation, hyperparameter-selection, masking, reference-update, and software information. The added author email supplies no new technical details or code/data access instructions.

R1.justification: The bibliography and positioning relative to length penalties, curated training data, prompt control, and classical Blackwell theory are identical.

P1.justification: v3 adds Alex Ayoub's email address and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose, terminology, and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added email expands the first-page author block and slightly shifts the abstract and introduction. Figures, tables, and all rendered pages from page 2 through page 18 are identical.

improvement.justification: v3 adds author contact information and makes small first-page layout adjustments, while retaining identical scientific content, results, and appendix proofs. These administrative changes do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
